description: List engineering patterns as id/path/title/status metadata from patterns/*/PATTERN.md, sorted by ID. Use it to discover a pattern ID before pattern_read; do not use it to fetch pattern text (use pattern_read instead) or to list modules/assets (module_read / asset_list). Returns metadata only, never the PATTERN.md body, with no pagination; no matches yields an empty list, and each call rescans the local patterns directory.
name: pattern_list

outputSchema.description: Wrapper for the pattern list; the payload is in items.

id.description: Pattern directory name accepted by pattern_read.

title.description: H1 title, or an empty string when absent.

title: List patterns
